messages:
Sam (AE): Kicking off POC with SummitBridge — they need SSO + SCIM, RBAC mapping, and domain-lock controls. Jen is the customer contact. Linh can you own the SE side? We also need a Dedicated pricing baseline for their expected usage.

Linh (SE): Got it. Quick Q: which IdP are they on? I’ll need SAML metadata + SCIM connector info. @Jen can you confirm vendor and share metadata?

Jen (Customer): We're on OneLogin (enterprise). I'll share the metadata and SCIM token. Timeline is a 2-week POC. Also need a domain verification step for auto-provisioning.

idp-bot: Reminder: upload SAML metadata in OneLogin before testing SSO.

David (Solutions Eng): For RBAC: are we mapping IdP groups -> Redwood roles? Any custom claim requirements (e.g., manager, department)? Example mapping I expect: `okta_group: summitbridge-admins` -> Redwood role `admin`.

Jen (Customer): Correct — groups -> roles. SCIM should sync groups + users. Required user attrs: email, name, employeeId. Also want org admins limited to validated company email domain.

Priya (Security): Security checklist items: cert-rotation process, SCIM token rotation, audit logs, and encryption-at-rest + in-transit details. We'll need SOC2/ISO artifacts and confirmation on KMS options for Private deployments. @Sam I'll post our questionnaire in this thread.

Sam (AE): Noted. We'll confirm cert rotation behaviour. Linh — can you ballpark Dedicated pricing for ~50 concurrent inference sessions, ~100M tokens/month? We may offer short eval credits for POC.

Linh (SE): Rough estimate: mid-tier Dedicated commit fits that profile. Ballpark number ~ $XXk/month — I'll pull exact numbers with Sales Ops and share a formal quote. For the POC we can provide a 30-day eval credit to validate latency and provisioning.

David (Solutions Eng): Technical notes for the SE runbook: SCIM supports delta and full sync; default rate limits are 500 req/min (can request bump for the POC). OneLogin SCIM uses `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Test checklist: 1) upload SAML metadata to OneLogin, 2) test SSO login -> assert NameID and claims, 3) provision a user via SCIM POST /Users, 4) assign a group and verify role mapping in Redwood.

Jen (Customer): I'll email the metadata and MSA today. Also need a signed AUP for data handling.

Priya (Security): I'll attach the security answers + link to our encryption/KMS notes (we support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments). Also confirm we have audit log exports for SCIM and SAML events.

Sam (AE): Action items: Linh — spin up test tenant and post SSO test URL by EOD. David — draft RBAC mapping template. Priya — prep security questionnaire answers. Jen — share metadata + desired group->role mappings. Ping this thread when items are done. :thumbsup:

Linh (SE): Test tenant created: https://rbwd-test.redwood.ai/summitbridge — SAML ACS endpoint: `https://rbwd-test.redwood.ai/saml/acs`. Upload metadata to OneLogin and confirm whether NameID will be `email` or `transient`.

Jen (Customer): Uploading now. NameID will be `email`. Also FYI their admin wants monthly cert rotation.

Linh (SE): We support metadata/cert rotation without downtime if done via the metadata update flow. Steps (short): run `curl -X POST /admin/saml/rotate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"` then check `/admin/saml/status` until `ACTIVE`. Documentation: https://redwood.ai/docs/saml-rotation

David (Solutions Eng): I'll drop a minimal `roles.json` template into the repo and paste an example mapping here. Example: `{"role":"admin","idp_group":"summitbridge-admins"}` — Jen, use and return with your groups.

Sam (AE): Great. I'll follow up with a formal quote tomorrow morning and attach the security questionnaire. Anything else blocking?

Jen (Customer): No blockers on my side; will send metadata + group mapping within 2 hrs.

Linh (SE): Starting SSO smoke tests now, will post results in thread.
